prompt: The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Cities have grown considerably, and providing sufficient housing for families has become one of the major challenges faced by authorities. It is argued that constructing tall apartment blocks is the most efficient way to address housing shortages in large cities. I completely agree with this view because high-rise buildings make more efficient use of limited land and can provide a more affordable and viable form of housing for urban families.

Firstly, it should be emphasized that available land in densely populated cities is extremely limited, particularly in major urban areas in Europe and North America. As many developed cities are already heavily built up, constructing large numbers of detached houses would only exacerbate the shortage of available land. For instance, in densely populated cities such as New York, limited space makes it increasingly difficult and expensive for families to purchase individual houses with private yards. High-rise apartment blocks, by contrast, can accommodate hundreds of households on a relatively small area of land. Therefore, vertical housing represents a more sustainable way of meeting the needs of a growing urban population.

Secondly, apartment living can alleviate the financial burden associated with purchasing and maintaining a detached house. Constructing one apartment block capable of accommodating hundreds of families is generally more cost-effective than developing the same number of individual houses. In addition, apartments often require lower maintenance costs, making them a more viable alternative for young families and people with limited financial resources. Consequently, increasing the supply of high-rise housing could contribute to making accommodation more accessible while allowing cities to use scarce land more efficiently.

To conclude, I completely agree that constructing tall apartment blocks is one of the most effective ways to address housing shortages in large cities. Such developments can both alleviate housing costs and provide a more sustainable solution to the problem of limited urban space.
